Summary

Freelance Test Automation / Release Engineer – Next.js / PostgreSQL

We are looking for an experienced freelance Test Automation / Release Engineer to help prepare Itanera for launch.

Itanera is a multilingual travel platform for Morocco, Egypt and Jordan, running in EN, DE, FR, IT and ES.

Stack: Next.js / TypeScript, PostgreSQL / PostGIS, Directus, Docker, GitHub Actions, Bunny CDN and Scaleway.

Testing and CI already exist. We want an independent engineer to review the current setup and strengthen the automated testing and release gates before production.

You will receive a current technical handoff from the existing developer and database architect covering the deployed code/database state, CI/tests, critical flows, migrations, architecture baseline and known open issues.

Immediate availability is required.

Engagement

This is an hourly / time-and-materials engagement.

I currently estimate the initial work at approximately 20–30 hours, depending on what is found.

We will have an initial checkpoint after approximately 4–6 hours to review findings, approach and progress before continuing.

Scope

- Review the existing automated tests and CI setup.
- Strengthen GitHub Actions gates so required failures are explicit and block merge.
- Build Playwright E2E automation for launch-critical flows.
- Add repeatable automated testing of PostgreSQL migrations on both fresh and existing databases.
- Identify which existing manual QA checks should become automated.
- Define checks for staging → production releases, rollback and post-deployment verification.
- Establish the automated QA gate used before merge/release.
- Document the setup and findings clearly.

Critical flows include the traveller request form and, where implemented, partner assignment.

Boundaries

This is not an architecture, general code-review or feature-development role.

The database architect owns architecture decisions. The product owner owns product and business approval.

Required

- Playwright or similar E2E framework
- GitHub Actions
- PostgreSQL and migration testing
- CI/CD
- Docker
- Next.js / TypeScript testing
- Clear written English

Nice to have: Directus, Scaleway, multilingual/i18n testing.
